# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Games

## I. Path & Connection Puzzles
Games involving drawing or tracing paths, connections, or loops

### A. Loop Formation
- **Closed Loops**: Dotchi-Loop, Mid-loop, Slitherlink
- **Open Paths**: Hashiwokakero, Numberlink, Nagareru
- **Hybrid Path Types**: Masyu

### B. Line Drawing
- **Single Continuous Lines**: Hebi, Suraromu
- **Multiple Path Elements**: Pencils

---

## II. Coloring & Shading Puzzles
Games involving marking or coloring cells according to constraints

### A. Binary Coloring (Shaded/Unshaded)
- **Constraint-Based Shading**: Akari, Hitori, Kurodoko, Nurikabe, Nuritwin
- **Pattern-Based Shading**: Heyawake, Norinori, Satogaeri
- **Boundary-Based Shading**: Nurimisaki, Sto-stone

### B. Multi-Color or Specific Marking
- **Color Assignment**: Ripple Effect, Tilepaint, Usowan
- **Specific Symbols**: Moon-or-Sun

---

## III. Polyomino & Tiling Puzzles
Games involving placing or identifying polyomino shapes

### A. Polyomino Placement
- **Free Placement**: Evolomino, LITS, Shikaku
- **Constrained Placement**: Chained Block, Fillomino, Five Cells, Sashigane

### B. Polyomino Identification
- **Shape Recognition**: Choco Banana, Double Choco, Makaro, Yosenabe

---

## IV. Number & Logic Puzzles
Games using numerical constraints and logical deduction

### A. Sudoku-Based
- **Standard Variants**: Sudoku

### B. Number Placement
- **Grid Constraints**: Juosan, Nansuke, Kurotto
- **Regional Constraints**: Yajilin

### C. Counting & Measurement
- **Cell Counting**: Shakashaka

---

## V. Hybrid & Complex Puzzles
Games combining multiple puzzle mechanics

- Nurimeizu (coloring + connectivity)
- Slitherlink (loop + constraint satisfaction)

---

**Note**: Some games could reasonably fit multiple categories. This taxonomy prioritizes the primary mechanic or most distinctive feature of each puzzle type.
